send.title: Send for analysis?
send.intro: Before the analysis starts, this leaves your computer:
send.dest_cli: The text goes to the local process "{command}". It does not leave your computer — where that tool sends it is up to its own configuration.
send.dest_anthropic: The text goes to api.anthropic.com, model {model}.
send.web_on: The first {limit} factual claims are sent as search queries to api.search.brave.com.
send.web_on_all: Every factual claim is sent as a search query to api.search.brave.com.
send.web_off: Nothing goes to the web — no Brave Search API key is stored.

onboarding.welcome_body: Paste an AI answer. PROVE breaks it into individual claims, labels each one as a verifiable fact, an inference, an opinion, or an internal contradiction, and tries to check the factual ones against the web.
onboarding.welcome_note: PROVE is not an arbiter of truth. It shows you what can be checked and with what — the judgment stays yours.
onboarding.privacy_local: Analyses, settings, and the cache stay in the app's data folder on your disk. No telemetry, nothing sent to us.
onboarding.privacy_llm: The text goes to whichever LLM provider you pick in the next step — either a local CLI tool or the Anthropic API.
onboarding.privacy_web: If you store a Brave Search API key, individual factual claims are sent as search queries. Without a key, nothing goes to the web.
onboarding.privacy_keys: API keys are stored in the system keychain, not in the settings file.
onboarding.privacy_confirm: Before every analysis you see an exact summary and have to confirm it. This can be turned off in Settings.
onboarding.provider_title: Choose how to call the LLM
onboarding.provider_body: The recommended option is a local CLI tool you already have — nothing extra to pay for, and the app itself sends the text nowhere.
onboarding.brave_optional: Brave Search API key (optional, for web verification)
onboarding.ready_hotkey: Press {hotkey} anywhere in the system — PROVE opens and pre-fills from your clipboard.
onboarding.ready_body: The hotkey, language, and verification depth are all changeable in Settings.

history.title: History
history.empty: Nothing here yet. Analyses are saved automatically.
history.delete_confirm_body: The record is permanently removed from your computer.
history.clear_confirm_body: Every saved analysis is permanently removed from your computer. This cannot be undone.
history.retention_hint: Older analyses are deleted when the app starts. 'Forever' deletes nothing.

settings.title: Settings
settings.cli_command_hint: The command receives the prompt on stdin and must print JSON to stdout. Use a preset above or enter a custom command.
settings.brave_key_hint: Without a key, facts are processed without web source verification.
settings.verified_limit_label: Claims to verify against the internet
settings.verified_limit_hint: Higher values verify more factual claims against the web — more thorough, but slower and more web searches. 'All' verifies every factual claim. Needs a Brave Search API key (above); without one, nothing is web-verified.
settings.key_present: Key is stored in the system keychain.
settings.brave_key_missing_optional: Key is not stored. Web source verification will be disabled.
settings.check_updates_hint: When enabled, the app makes one GET request to GitHub on launch to see if a newer version exists. No data is sent and no download or install happens automatically.
settings.confirm_before_send_hint: Shows exactly what is sent and where before every analysis. Turning this off starts the analysis immediately.

hotkey.hint: Click, then press a combination. Escape cancels. It needs at least one modifier (or be a function key).
hotkey.rejected: That combination cannot be used. Try another.

footer.disclaimer: Even PROVE cannot guarantee 100% accuracy of the content. The app aims to help reduce the spread of misinformation — the final judgment is always yours.

error.title: Analysis failed
error.cli_not_found: The program from your CLI command was not found. Check that it is installed and on your PATH.
error.cli_failed: The CLI command exited with an error. Try running it manually in a terminal and read the output.
error.cli_timeout: The CLI command did not answer in time. Try a shorter input or a faster model.
error.cli_bad_output: The CLI command did not return valid JSON. Make sure it prints only the model's answer.
error.llm_auth: Anthropic rejected the API key. Check it in Settings.
error.llm_rate_limit: Anthropic is rate-limiting you. Try again in a moment.
error.llm_http: Anthropic returned an error. Try again in a moment.
error.search_auth: Brave Search rejected the API key. Check it in Settings.
error.search_rate_limit: Brave Search is rate-limiting you. Try again in a moment.
error.search_http: Brave Search returned an error. Try again in a moment.
error.network: Could not reach the network. Check your connection.
error.keychain: Could not reach the system keychain.
error.store: Could not read or write settings.
error.io: Could not read or write a file.
error.serde: The data had an unexpected shape.
error.hotkey: The hotkey could not be registered. Another app is probably using it.
error.not_found: The requested item does not exist.
